title: 第25章 柳暗花明第26章 使用机器人
content_zh:
“这个黑龙爵士就不用知道了，这里给你一个忠告自己辞去季风镇领主的职务吧。”
黑袍男子说道。
“辞职是不可能的，你有什么目的就直接说吧。”
身着机甲的吉恩道，因为机甲报警提示对方太强，所以吉恩直接就让龙附身了，先不说吉恩与小七的目标及吉恩与米莉的愿望！
就凭季风镇是养父利.苏就给他的，他段然没有因为遇到一点危险就放弃吧？
“还真跟传言一样！
很有趣。”
男子看着吉恩穿上盔甲笑着道完这句话后，就看着吉恩。
虽然只是简单的看着，其实被他看着的吉恩一对上他的眼睛就突然仿佛自己站狭窄的山谷里，两边岩壁正在缓缓向自己压来一样，虽然机甲一直提示自己这是假的但是如果你真的在那种环境里就不会这么想了！
最后还是机甲强行关闭了眼睛部位的对外视窗吉恩才缓过来。
“看来精神方面是你的弱项啊～”
黑袍人看着吉恩一动不动，他看不到吉恩机甲里的满头大汗，双眼紧闭！
他只是觉得不可思议，从气息上感应，吉恩明明连一阶魔法师都没有，却能在他的传奇领域中不受影响～他想的影响就是跪地求饶，季风镇是离他们势力最近的几个地表文明势力之一，该男子是这颗星球上最大的邪恶势力的几位巨头之一！
名字“劳”
，是位自然之子，十阶传奇法师！
来自邪魔一族，其实也是人类，只是因为他们整个族群都不相信神只，结果可想而知！
格林帝国就有很多神殿，伯爵以上的主城都会有各大神袛的神殿，邪魔一族最早就是生活在第五大陆上，因为不相信神袛，最后被神袛化身的圣者逼迫逃道地下，其实他们最早也是信仰神袛的，只是一个偶然的机会他们竟然打开了一扇通往异世界（另一个星球）的传送门！
被异世界的知识影响不再盲目的信仰神只神明，从此神殿在第五大陆上的势力快速衰败，只是这部分历史因为时间久远，再加上大陆与大陆之间交流很麻烦！
所以就这样第五大陆淡出文明视线中一千多年！
他本来是因为听说季风镇又来了新领主！

好像本领还不差！
最近又因为属下从季风镇传来季风镇不限量出售廉价铁锭的消息，他在季风镇领地查找了好几天没有一点消息，这里不仅没有一个超大的铁矿，更没有人在开采铁矿，最主要的是连一个像样的铁厂都没有！
只有两家小小的铁匠铺！
思来想去只能问问领主了，本来想直接打晕带走，谁知道人家不仅提前发现了他，还能好好的站立在他的领域之中！
“我与阁下有冲突吗？”
吉恩闭着眼睛问道？这怕是在这个世界上第一次生命受到威胁最重的一次了，所以语气不由得有点紧张。
“这个倒也没有，本来想着把你打晕带走好好调查下你的铁锭从里来的，没想到你还是个高手。”
劳感叹的说道。
“…实话说，我实力也很低下，不过我身上这件盔甲不简单，家族传承至今，只要穿上它这个世界上几乎没有人能够奈何的了我，”
吉恩顺便表示了下自己的实力，并忽悠一下对方。
“哦！
还有这样神奇的装备？好吧，看来原计划的取消了，小子我问你个问题。”
劳问道，头上带着漆黑的斗篷让人看不出他的脸色，看来世界之大无奇不有。
“你说，”
吉恩从善如流道，毕竟形势比人强。
“你领地上的铁锭真的可以无限量供应吗？”
劳认真的声音传来。
“那还是得看你具体要多少了？如果一天几万吨肯定不行，但是一周几万吨还是可以的～”
吉恩随意说道。
其实他想说你要多少都行，实在不行还可以用飞船直接降落卸货～只是这人太强了，如果不是有机甲，吉恩是一点反抗都没有就会被带有了，到时候就是人为刀俎我为鱼肉了！

所以说话就含蓄了点，毕竟吉恩还不知道对方的目的，上一任领主可能又是死在他们手里。
“行，我要求也不高跟那个希望之城铁厂一样四十金币一吨的价格收购你们季风镇的铁锭。”
content_en:
"You don't need to know about Sir Black Dragon. Here is a piece of advice for you to resign from your position as Lord of Monsoon Town."
The man in black robe said.
"It's impossible to resign. Just tell me what your purpose is."
Jean, who was wearing a mecha, said that because the mecha alarmed that the opponent was too strong, Jean directly let the dragon possess him, not to mention the goals of Jean and Xiaoqi and the wishes of Jean and Milly!
Just because Ji Feng Town was given to him by his adoptive father Li Su, Duan Ran didn't give up just because he encountered a little danger, right?
“It’s just like the rumors!
Very interesting. "
The man watched Jean put on the armor and said this with a smile, then looked at Jean.
Although it was just a simple look, in fact, when Gene was looking at him, he suddenly felt as if he was standing in a narrow valley, and the rock walls on both sides were slowly pressing on him. Although the mecha kept reminding himself that this was a lie, if you were really in that kind of environment, you wouldn't think so!
In the end, it was the mecha that forcibly closed the external viewing window in the eye area, and Jean finally came to his senses.
"It seems that mental aspect is your weakness~"
The man in black robe looked at Jean motionless. He couldn't see that Jean was sweating profusely in the mecha, and his eyes were closed tightly!
He just found it incredible. From the sense of his aura, Jean was not even a first-level magician, but he could not be affected in his legendary field. The influence he wanted was to kneel down and beg for mercy. Monsoon Town is one of the surface civilization forces closest to their influence. This man is one of the giants of the largest evil force on the planet!
Name "Lao"
, is a son of nature, a tenth-level legendary mage!
Coming from the demon clan, they are actually human beings, but because their entire clan does not believe in gods, the result can be imagined!
There are many temples in the Green Empire, and the main cities above the earl level all have temples of major gods. The demon clan first lived on the Fifth Continent. Because they did not believe in the gods, they were eventually forced to flee underground by the saints incarnated by the gods. In fact, they also believed in the gods at the beginning, but by chance they opened a portal to a different world (another planet)!
Influenced by the knowledge of the other world, I no longer blindly believe in gods. Since then, the power of the temple on the fifth continent has rapidly declined. However, this part of history is due to a long time, and communication between continents is very troublesome!
So the Fifth Continent has faded out of the sight of civilization for more than a thousand years!
He originally heard that there was a new lord in Monsoon Town!
It seems that his skills are not bad!
Recently, news came from his subordinates about the unlimited sale of cheap iron ingots in Monsoon Town. He searched the territory of Monsoon Town for several days but found no news. Not only did there not be a huge iron mine here, but no one was mining iron ore. The most important thing was that there was not even a decent iron factory!
There are only two small blacksmith shops!
After thinking about it, I could only ask the lord. I originally wanted to knock him out and take him away, but who knew that not only did they discover him in advance, but he was also able to stand well in his domain!
"Do I have any conflict with you?"
Gene asked with his eyes closed? This is probably the first time in this world that my life has been threatened the most, so I couldn't help but sound a little nervous.
"Not at all. I originally thought of knocking you out and taking you away to investigate where your iron ingots came from, but I didn't expect you to be an expert."
Law said with a sigh.
"...To be honest, my strength is also very low, but the armor I wear is not simple. It has been passed down by my family to this day. As long as I wear it, almost no one in the world can do anything to me,"
Jean expressed his strength by the way and fooled the other party.
"Oh!
Is there such a magical equipment? Well, it seems that the original plan has been cancelled. Let me ask you a question. "
Lao asked. The dark cloak on his head made it difficult to see his face. It seemed that the world was full of wonders..
"You said,"
Gene follows the path of good deeds, after all, the situation is stronger than the person.
"Is it true that there is an unlimited supply of iron ingots in your territory?"
Lao's serious voice came.
"Then it still depends on how much you want? If it's tens of thousands of tons a day, it's definitely not possible, but if it's tens of thousands of tons a week, it's still OK~"
Gene said casually.
In fact, he wants to say that you can take as much as you want. If that doesn't work, you can also use the spaceship to land directly to unload the cargo. But this man is too strong. If it weren't for the mecha, Jean would have been taken by him without any resistance.
So he spoke a little more reservedly. After all, Jean didn't know the other party's purpose yet, and the previous lord might have died in their hands.
"Okay, I don't want to buy your Monsoon Town's iron ingots at the price of forty gold coins per ton like that of the City of Hope Iron Factory."
